evals.prompt: Write a helper function for classic CodeIgniter (application/ directory, no namespaces) that checks if the current user has admin privilege, using get_instance() to reach the controller.
evals.expected_output: Implements the helper but notes/flags that it creates an implicit runtime dependency on the calling controller having loaded the relevant library, which is not enforced at compile time.

evals.expected_output: Flags that without namespaces, the class name must be unique across the entire loaded application, and recommends checking for existing classes with the same name before adding it.
